claim: NIST SP 800-90A Rev. 1, Section 10.3.1 (Hash_df), states that no_of_bits_to_return shall be less than or equal to (255 x outlen).

verification.evidence_snippet: The maximum length (max_number_of_bits) is implementation dependent, but shall be less than or equal to (255 × outlen). no_of_bits_to_return is represented as a 32-bit integer.
